integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational/symbolic and high-precision tests are provided. General Nyström capture objective is credited to prior literature. The reported mathematical review is same-model only, with independent validation unperformed. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent work.
scientific_limitations: Exact single-column capture only, unit-weight ordinary paths, uniform positive screening; full half-line trace diverges and only finite rank-one gain is optimized; finite-path switching asymptotics are for each fixed depth as path size increases; no complete small-size phase diagram or multi-column claim.
title: A boundary-layer staircase and exponential finite-size shifts for screened-path Nyström landmarks
